title: Pass Git a readable attributes path on Windows so task-sync materialization's staged attribute check stops refusing every tree
outcome: Keep task-sync materialization's staged attribute check working on Windows when the repository path is long
acceptance: On Windows, `task-sync setup-materialize` approves a policy-safe .engram tree and still refuses an unsafe one; the staged attributes file handed to Git via core.attributesFile is a path Git for Windows can open (no \\?\ verbatim prefix), and a test proves both outcomes
`cargo test --test task_sync_materialize_cli` passes on Windows from any checkout or linked worktree
If Git cannot read the attributes file it is given, the check refuses with a named reason instead of reporting text unset
